problem.text: You made a video worth sharing. Reaching another language means translating, recording, matching the timing and building subtitles. Then doing it all again.

product.text: VibeRick Dub handles that workflow. Paste your video link and choose your languages. Get dubbed video, audio tracks and subtitles you can download and use.

conversation.text: The reply keeps a different voice, while subtitles follow its actual speech.

pipeline.text: A translation also has to fit the time a speaker actually talks. Chirp supplies word timestamps. Gemini translates for those windows. We measure each generated take, adjust wording or pace, and check the language, content and meaning.

repair.text: In this recorded run, the checker caught a Japanese line spoken in Korean. The pipeline generated another take. Problems it cannot resolve stay flagged.

voice.text: With consent, creators can use their own voice. Here is the original, then the English version.

architecture.text: Firebase hosts the studio. Firestore carries progress. Cloud Run executes the API and workers, with media in Cloud Storage. Completed languages become available independently.

finish.text: Switch languages without losing your place. Download the video, audio or subtitles. Fine-tune a line only when needed. You made the video. We handle the languages.
